context_notes: Wave-based worktree-parallel execution of phase 07.1 (9 plans, 7 waves). 6 of 9 plans merged clean to master (HEAD b388897). Wave 5's executor was killed by the user mid-commit for pacing/session-end reasons, not due to any failure - its work is intact and staged in its worktree. No corruption, no data loss. Three anti-patterns worth reading before resuming: gsd_run query commit's internal timeout is shorter than this repo's full test suite (use direct git commit with a long timeout instead), master can move independently mid-wave (always recompute merge-base fresh), and ./gradlew --stop on the main tree can crash a concurrently-running worktree's Gradle daemon (avoid running it on the main tree while any executor is active).
